name: bench-pygments
title: Pygments' example files (tests/examplefiles), labelled by the lexer of their directory
labels: Pygments' maintainers (the example's directory, a lexer alias), crosswalked to Linguist's names
sampling: curated (Pygments' example files, all of those in a language)
strengths: wide: 431 lexers, 176 files in languages Linguist does not have
real file names chosen by the maintainers, 114 with an extension several Linguist languages claim
independent of Linguist: only 15 files are Linguist samples
weaknesses: Pygments' home turf: its lexers are tested on these very files, and its taxonomy is the label set
test files, often written to exercise a lexer's corners rather than typical code
one to a few files per lexer (26 Scala files, 14 GraphQL), so per-language figures are anecdotal
